model.title: Western Wildfire Support Act of 2025
model.meta: Energy and Natural Resources Committee · Sen. Catherine Cortez Masto (D-NV)

summary.text: The bill would authorize federal funding and coordination for wildfire response, recovery, and prevention efforts in western states. It aims to establish emergency response teams and rehabilitation accounts for burned areas, accelerate adoption of detection technology and drones for fire management, provide equipment funding to tribal nations, and improve coordination between federal and state agencies on fire suppression and training.
